benchmarks.indicator: Average monthly earnings of employees by sex (total)
limitations: National average for employees, not occupation-specific.
Not representative of self-employed or informal workers as a separate occupation-specific population.
Do not display as the salary of any individual M-TIER occupation.
Reference year 2022; refresh before use in a current salary decision.

display_rule: This figure may appear only in a Benin labour-market context panel, never as the salary estimate for a particular occupation.
